d: Will lead the engineering design function for the data center developments, overseeing the design of MEP and CSA Infrastructure, as well as related systems across new-build, retrofit and expansions projects. The role owns design standards, leads a team of design engineers or technical specialists, and works closely with project delivery teams to deliver reliable, efficient and scalable data center facilities.
q: Minimum of 10 years’ experience in large scale Middle Eastern experience for Data Center design and technical engineering.
Excellent understanding of the complexity of data centers and demonstrable experience of design and delivery of large-scale data center facilities across multiple countries.
Recognized industry leader; strong executive presence; solid track record of strategic accomplishments in companies experiencing rapid growth and expansion where constant challenges are the norm.
Multinational leadership experience, willingness to reconsider constantly innovative ways to reduce cost through creative design. Should not be constrained by traditional processes.
Fully understands the priorities around safety, time, cost, and quality with a strong emphasis on delivery to budget.
Commercially astute with a strong business acumen, appreciating the responsibilities of Design in the context to the whole business strategy.
r: Lead the end-to-end design process for data center projects, from concept through detailed design, construction support, and commissioning handover.
Own and continuously improve design standards, specifications, and basis-of-design documents.
Review and approve designs, calculations, and drawings prepared by internal teams or external consultants / contractors.
Drive design optimization from energy efficiency, reliability, modularity, speed to build with considerations of customer requirements as well as cost to build across all projects.
Continuously explore the latest technologies on the market and support internal design & innovation projects.

Lead internal standardization initiative covering not only design related documents but also project management, construction management, commissioning management & etc., which are supported by relevant discipline leads.
Build, mentor, and manage a team of design engineers and coordinate with external design consultants.
Set performance goals, conduct reviews, and support career development of direct reports.
Allocate resources across multiple concurrent projects and manage workload and priorities.
Evaluate and select power and cooling technologies appropriate to project requirements and industry trends (including AI/high-density rack cooling).
Evaluate and select appropriate construction method from CSA side to project requirements as well as customers’ standards.
Review vendor equipment selections, capacity calculations, etc.
Lead value engineering exercises to balance cost, reliability, and schedule.
Coordinate closely with project delivery teams to ensure integrated design delivery.
Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory bodies on design related matters.
Work with operations/facilities teams to ensure designs support maintainability and operational requirements.
Manage design timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple sites/projects.
Present design solutions and technical recommendations to senior leadership and clients.
Ensure compliance with local codes, standards (e.g., ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, TIA-942, LEED & etc.), and sustainability / energy regulations.

d: We are looking for a goal-driven, fashion-forward Sales Representative to expand the presence of our color contact lens brand. You will drive account acquisition and sales growth across optical retailers, beauty stores, pharmacies, and e-commerce partners.

The ideal candidate combines a strong commercial and marketing foundation with experience in fashion, beauty, or cosmetics. You are passionate about consumer trends, skilled at developing lasting business relationships, and motivated to deliver revenue growth.
q: Education: Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum 3 years of proven sales experience, ideally in B2B or trade sales.
Industry background: Prior experience in fashion, beauty, or cosmetics is required.
Communication: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Commercial mindset: Strong understanding of sales metrics, trade margins, product positioning, and visual merchandising.
r: Sales & account management: Identify, target, and onboard new retail accounts across relevant channels.
Relationship building: Maintain and grow customer relationships to drive repeat orders and increase sales.
Market & trend analysis: Monitor beauty and eye-care trends, competitor activity, and customer feedback to identify new opportunities.
Product presentations: Deliver product presentations and promotional demonstrations to retail teams and prospective clients.
In-store marketing: Implement and optimize point-of-sale (POS) and merchandising materials to strengthen brand visibility.
Promotional execution: Collaborate with marketing teams on trade promotions, in-store merchandising, and co-marketing campaigns.
Pipeline & forecasting: Monitor pipeline activity and sales targets; prepare regular sales reports and demand forecasts.
